# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# Runtime dependencies of the pure-Python layers: the Mission Intent schema and
# compiler (mission/) and the space keep-out predictor and intent schema (space/).
#
# These two packages are all that is needed to run the mission compiler, the
# labelled corpus and the analytic keep-out predictor on a laptop, with no
# container, no ROS 2 and no PX4 build:
#
#     pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# Pins are declared in versions.env (M17 / G-S2). Do not edit a version here
# without editing that file; `python3 scripts/check_reproducible.py --pins`
# fails on drift.
#
# The SITL scenarios, the C++ arbiter and the monitor generation need the
# containers instead; see README "Reproduce it".
PyYAML>=6.0
jsonschema>=4.0
